ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 46 / OppVR66] Close Date cannot be changed once signature is captured (CLM), in Booking Verification/Booked/Setup/Closed/Lost. Uses Deal_Close_Date_Locked__c (same indicator as Deal_Close_Date_Finalized). Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( Deal_Close_Date_Locked__c,
ISCHANGED(CloseDate),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date is locked. You cannot update the Close Date after the Customer Signature has been received.
